title: Hearty Smoky American Bacon Skillet
description: A charred, tender, show-off American dish featuring bacon lardon, bain-marie, high-protein-friendly ingredients, perfect for a hearty breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the bacon into lardon and cook in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the cooked bacon from the skillet and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until they start to soften.
Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and continue to cook until they are tender.
Create 6 wells in the skillet and crack an egg into each well.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the eggs and potatoes.
Season with salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika to taste.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to desired doneness.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top with the cooked bacon lardon.
